name: barrier
algorithm: t workers (Mk: tasks; Rust: OS threads) wait r rounds at one barrier of t and count the rounds each led. Prints the leaders (r) and r (README.md).

skip.c: no barrier in standard C (pthread_barrier_t is POSIX, SynchronizationBarrier is Win32)
skip.go: no barrier in Go's std (a sync.WaitGroup serves one round, not a reusable barrier)
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the counters, which stay below 2^40

no_counts: B24 does not apply: one leader per round, r in all, shows every round completed once
notes: Concurrency row (B19): mask 0x5555, 8 threads. Rust uses OS threads, labelled so.
Written by std-sync2 (status/std-sync2.md, M6 session 1); checksums from the workload's arithmetic.
